steps.text: 1. The Admin opens the "Reported tours" page.
2. The system returns tours with open reports, sorted by report count descending, flagged tours first, then oldest reports first (20 items per page). E1, E2.

exceptions.text: E1. No reported tours → "No reported tours".
E2. No valid token → 401; not an Admin → 403; invalid pagination parameters → 400.

steps.text: 4. The system shows the record: tour summary, links to the public page and the author's account (UC#21), open reports (reason, note, time, reporter ID), the number of dismissed / resolved reports and the Admin action history. E3.

exceptions.text: E3. Invalid tour ID format → 400; the tour does not exist → 404.

steps.text: 5. The Admin chooses "Hide tour", enters a reason (required, 1–1000 characters) in the "Hide this tour?" dialog and confirms. A1, A2, A3, E5.

exceptions.text: E5. Missing reason when hiding, or a reason over 1000 characters (hide, restore, dismiss) → 422, the error shows in the dialog.

steps.text: 6. In one transaction, the system moves the tour Public → Hidden, marks the open reports as resolved, clears the counter and the flag, and writes the hide_tour log. E4.

exceptions.text: E4. The status does not allow it (hiding a tour that is not public, restoring a tour that is not hidden, dismissing when no reports are open) → 409; when two Admins act at the same time, only one wins; the client shows the error and reloads the record.

steps.text: 7. The system publishes tour.hidden (and tour.unpublished to remove it from the chatbot); Notification creates a notification and sends an email to the author; the client shows "Tour hidden and the author notified" and reloads the record. E6.

exceptions.text: E6. A failed event publish is only logged; the decision is still saved.

steps: A1.1. The Admin opens the record of a hidden tour (from the action log or the author's account page), chooses "Restore" and confirms "Restore the tour?" (reason optional).
A1.2. The system moves the tour back to Public (no new review), writes the restore_tour log and publishes tour.restored; the author receives a notification and an email "Tour … is visible again". E4.
A2.1. The Admin chooses "Dismiss reports" and confirms "Dismiss the reports?" when the tour has open reports.
A2.2. The system marks the reports as dismissed, clears the counter, keeps the tour status and writes the dismiss_reports log; no event is published. E4.
A3. Handle the author's account: the Admin opens the author's account page and performs UC#21.
